candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis specifies 'Effusive-constrictive pericarditis', indicating both effusive and constrictive components. The candidate only mentions 'Constrictive Pericarditis', omitting the effusive aspect. While the clinical record supports constrictive features (thickened pericardium, ventricular interdependence, septal bounce, hemodynamic findings), it also shows signs of effusion (increased IVC size with reduced inspiratory collapse, right ventricular dysfunction, and elevated right atrial pressure which can be seen in effusive-constrictive pericarditis).
